description: Four voltage-controlled amplifiers whose outputs fall through into one another, which makes the module a mixer as well

params.text: Sets the level of that channel, silent at the bottom of its travel and unity at the top
Chooses whether the CV input scales that channel in a straight line or exponentially

inputs.text: Scales that channel's level, 0V to 10V; with nothing patched the slider alone sets it

outputs.text: Carries that channel summed with every lower-numbered channel whose own output is unpatched, so the last patched output gives the mix

notes: Leave a channel's own output unpatched and that channel is added to the next one's output instead, so with only the last channel's output patched all four arrive there as a mix.
